body.p: When you use the Oxygen AI Translator add-on, a translation task represents a complete translation workflow. It leverages the AI connectors and models configured in the Oxygen AI Positron to translate XLIFF translation units. Each task works with a specific XLIFF file, an optional translation memory (TMX), and custom user instructions. It also applies the selected AI translation configuration to help ensure high-quality translations.

ul.li: AI-Powered Translation - Translation tasks use the AI connectors and models configured in Oxygen AI Positron, ensuring consistent settings across Oxygen tools. This integration gives you access to different AI engines and lets you choose the model that best fits your translation needs.

Quality Assurance with Built-in Checks - Every translation task includes a built-in quality check that reviews the accuracy and quality of translations. This system checks the translated content to make sure it keeps the original formatting and structure.

Retry Translation System - If the quality check detects issues in a translation, the system can automatically retry the translation by using different models. This step-by-step approach allows the use of more advanced models to achieve the best translation quality.
Parallel Task Execution - The add-on lets you run multiple translation tasks at the same time, which can increase productivity and speed up large translation projects.
Configurable Translation Settings - You can fully edit translation settings through the preferences interface, letting you customize AI models, retry options, and quality check parameters.
